completion_criteria.text: A DETAILED, APPROVED spec exists that makes ALL mitosis git actions performable without fail
The spec eliminates every fabricated-consent / classifier-bypass path (no self-asserted authorization)
The spec makes mitosis NEVER run `gh pr merge` (merge structurally removed, not gated); all PRs stay open; dependents stack on the parent's open-PR HEAD; humans merge outside mitosis
The spec grounds every load-bearing rule in deterministic Claude Code harness/git/server enforcement (never prose), each proven by a red->green demonstration
The spec preserves idempotent resume + reconcile without stable-name ref overwrites (content-addressed create-only refs + compare-and-swap), with concrete re-keying
The spec is grounded by the approved report + deep-audit artifact and survives adversarial review

spine.active_goal: REDIRECTED by 0009: TEAR DOWN MSP-2 and MSP-3, replacing them with a ROBUST + SIMPLE architecture in two halves. (1) A GitHub ruleset plus a SEPARATE machine-user identity becomes THE merge boundary, so the fail-open client layers get DELETED. (2) RESTACK becomes deterministic (0010) - a stacked PR train, not merge prevention, is the real requirement. MSP-3b is retired as UNNECESSARY (G1: workflow agents never run bypassPermissions), not broken.
spine.next_step: Proceed with the teardown-and-replace goal; think hard. Order: (1) research the UNCOVERED half - restack determinism + build-vs-delegate (Graphite/ghstack/spr/git-town); verify the auto-retarget-on-base-deletion lead EARLY. (2) Execute the 0009 teardown set; stash@{0} drop needs EXPLICIT human confirm. (3) Author the human runbook (machine-user + PAT + ruleset) - agent authors, HUMAN applies. (4) Build the engine PREFLIGHT that PARKS a run unless ruleset + non-admin identity verify. Then MSP-4.

The researcher's report PREDATES the stacked-PR-train clarification. It does NOT cover restack determinism, stack depth, O(N^2) CI cost, or build-vs-delegate. Treat that half as UNRESEARCHED.

Top pre-mortem: the HUMAN-APPLIED steps never happen, the boundary never exists, and mitosis ships on a shared identity while everyone believes the server layer is live. The engine preflight is the mitigation and is NOT optional.

Option B (pr-opener agent) has ONE unprobed seam: whether frontmatter tools: narrowing binds WORKFLOW-spawned agents (composed from two doc statements). A 2-minute live probe settles it; if it does not bind, B is dead.
Do NOT restore the two D4 Write denies. main carries the INTENDED 38; a 38-vs-40 count is NOT a regression.

main is 35 commits ahead of origin/main and unpushed. Working tree still DIRTY (4 modified, 3 untracked); stash@{0} retained - do NOT discard without explicit confirm.

Two engine defects recorded not fixed: clean(undefined) TypeError, and conditional host enforcement accepting a same-slug FOREIGN-HOST merged PR. Their line numbers PREDATE the cd5c65d merge and have drifted - re-locate first.
The wrapper is NOT a security boundary while Bash(node:*) is live. Under 0009 that grant is now an ACCEPTED residual, not a defect to fix.
